I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message. The reply says the ticket for the gate kiosk outage at Quarrendon Freight Lines is OPS-7896, and that it replaces OPS-8447, the number from her 09:00 message.

I can't edit or delete the earlier messages, so the 09:00 thread still shows OPS-8447. The correction is now in the channel, posted after it. She said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else. A ticket number is an operational fact, so it's fine to have it in the team channel.
